method: ladder: probe --sweep with a 6.5 kHz sine (and 997 Hz as the control), the threshold at 6 norms, levels -30..-6 dBFS, GR = gain at the open end minus gain at the position; centre and mode: probe --response (121-tone multitone at -12 dBFS) at the hardest threshold against the open end, the deepest deviation's frequency (parabolic) is the centre; split_band = within 1 dB at 997 Hz while the band is cut 3 dB or more, wideband = 997 Hz cut within 1.5 dB of the band, else partial
